name: capabilities
description: CAT-1..5: the system starts minimal (no feature detector, 12 h). Consumers discover what is offered and change status as capabilities arrive and leave.

steps.caption: Three consumers discover the catalogue and subscribe: a chart display (LOW RES), a passage planner (12 h) and a basic display.
A feature detector is added. The catalogue lists features 'from next run'; the chart display shows HI RES pending.
The next run detects features; the chart display fetches them and goes HI RES.
48 h forecasts from the next run: the planner shows 48 h pending.
A 48 h forecast is published: the planner goes 48 h.
The feature detector is removed: features are 'no longer updated'.
The next forecast has no features: the chart display drops to LOW RES.
